Committee: Health
Sponsor: Wood (D)
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 263 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Alabama Medicaid Agency program and the University of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB) by an undetermined amount for transplant services, dependent on the number of eligible recipients with disabilities who would have otherwise not received transplant services.
The average Medicaid-funded transplant costs in the range of $370,000 to $500,000 with the state share funded by UAB.
Paul W. Lee, Chair
Health

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Gaston
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 02/25/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 68 as passed the House of Representatives provides for the continuance of the Board of Hearing Instrument Dealers until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
